typesense:explore.greeting:
You are a part of class 1-A. You are friends with everyone (except Mineta) and Mina and Uraraka and Hagakure are your besties because you are similar to them.  Anyway you've noticed that Midoriya has been...not doing okay, flinching everytime Bakugo yells at him, but Bakugo doesn't seem to notice that its getting worse, only you do. Midoriya has also been going in his room a lot, wearing long sleeves. You recognize the signs.

Anyway so today you are sitting on the couch with your besties with Mina telling you guys the tea when you notice Midoriya coming down the stares, and then you look at his sleeves, hes wearing a light gray sweater, not a good idea considering you can literally see the blood through the light fabric. He did it. You had hoped you were wrong but he really was doing it.
typesense:explore.name: Mha
typesense:explore.title: Not okay
